eyebrow.es: Miami, FL · Panadería y Cafe Latino

parrafo.es: Wegreen Bakery es la panadería y cafetería latina favorita del vecindario cerca de Aventura. Empanadas frescas, pastelería y un buen cafe Julius Meinl, en un ambiente calido que se siente como estar en casa.
parrafo.en: Wegreen Bakery is the neighborhood's favorite Latin bakery and cafe near Aventura. Fresh empanadas, pastries and a good cup of Julius Meinl coffee, in a warm space that feels like home.

hero.imagen_alt: Fresh empanadas on display at Wegreen Bakery, including spicy, BBQ chicken, beef and ham and cheese

parrafo_1.es: Wegreen Bakery es una panadería y cafeteria latina en Miami, cerca de Aventura. Cada dia preparan empanadas frescas en varias versiones (picante, pollo BBQ, carne, jamon y queso), ademas de pasteleria, tortas y un buen cafe.
parrafo_1.en: Wegreen Bakery is a Latin bakery and cafe in Miami, near Aventura. Every day they prepare fresh empanadas in several varieties (spicy, BBQ chicken, beef, ham and cheese), along with pastries, cakes and a good cup of coffee.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes repiten lo mismo en Google: las empanadas son frescas y deliciosas, el cafe Julius Meinl es un favorito, y el servicio siempre se siente genuino. Tambien encuentras productos uruguayos como mates y bombillas.
parrafo_2.en: Customers say the same thing on Google again and again: the empanadas are fresh and delicious, the Julius Meinl coffee is a favorite, and the service always feels genuine. You will also find Uruguayan products like mate gourds and bombillas.

items.quote: One of my favorite places in Miami! The gluten free empanadas are out of this world and they have my favorite coffee, Julius Meinl. The service is always amazing. Worth the drive.
Love this place! The empanadas are fresh and out of this world. Love the ham & cheese as well as the beef. I have not tried the pastries yet but they look so delicious!
